title: slopvac v3 doctor report
description: The document that `slopvac doctor --format json` prints. It reports the binary, update state, configuration sources, locked packs, plugin trust and the per-user directories. Doctor reads local files only and never changes them. Paths are relative to the working directory, or `<external>/<name>` outside it (policies.md, section 1.7). Unknown keys are errors, and keys that start with `x-` are ignored. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/doctor.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.12.5.

ok.description: True when nothing needs attention: configuration is valid, the lockfile parses, no pack is tampered and the trust store is readable. The exit code is 0 when true and 2 when false. An available update, a missing lockfile or an empty trust store do not make it false.

Path.description: A path made safe to print: relative to the working directory (`.` for the directory itself), or `<external>/<file name>` outside it.

Message.description: A human message with no absolute path. Not an interface: branch on the status fields.

install_method.description: How this binary was installed. `unknown` when no channel matches.

upgrade_command.description: The command that upgrades this install, or null when the channel is unknown.

os.description: Operating system, as Rust reports it (`linux`, `macos`, `windows`).

arch.description: CPU architecture, as Rust reports it (`x86_64`, `aarch64`).

Update.description: What the cached update check says. Doctor reads the cache and starts no request in this build.

disabled_by.description: Why checks are off: offline mode, the CI variable, an opt-out variable, or `[network] update_check = false`. Null when enabled.

state.description: `available` when the cached latest release is newer than the running version, `current` when it is not, `unknown` when no cached answer exists or the cached version is not a semantic version.

latest.description: The cached latest release version, or null.

checked_at.description: Unix seconds of the cached check, or null.

sources.description: Every source that turned offline on, in the order flag, env, config.

layer.description: `explicit` for a file named with `--config`, `project` for the nearest `slopvac.toml`, `extends` for a file either of them extends.

status.description: `ok` when the file parses and declares schema_version 3. `legacy` for a 2.x file (no schema_version or 2). `missing`, `unreadable` or `invalid` otherwise.

ok.description: True when every listed source has status `ok`. True with no sources: the defaults apply.

state.description: `recorded`: installed and intact. `in-place`: a project directory that matches the lock. `changed`: a project directory that differs from the lock. `tampered`: installed but differs from its record. `not-installed`: absent from the store.

status.description: `absent` is not an error: a project need not use packs.

items.description: One entry per locked pack, sorted by id. Empty unless the lockfile status is `ok`.

namespace.description: The pinned namespace, in the pack id pattern. Doctor reports a store that holds any other text as unreadable.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the public key, 64 lowercase hex digits, derived by doctor from the stored key. The key itself is never printed.

status.description: `absent` when no trust file exists yet.

source.description: How the location was chosen: an environment variable name, or `default`.

bytes.description: Total size of regular files found, or null when the directory does not exist. Counts at most 10000 entries.

truncated.description: True when the walk stopped at the entry limit, so `bytes` is a lower bound.
